# Agent with autogenerated model creation tools

This is an experiment with using EGL to autogenerate the tools,
prompts, and Pydantic models for an agent that builds up a subset
of an Ecore metamodel, using Pydantic as a middle layer.

## How to try out

```shell
cp .env.template .env
# customise .env with appropriate values
uv sync
uv run main.py samples/library.txt samples/library.flexmi
```

## To run tests

```shell
uv run -m pytest
```
